The nerve of claiming that moms.gov is there to help mothers!

Video

This isn't a one-off, and the threat of removing women's children isn't just happening in banned states.   

In the same article, I write about a mother who was investigated by both CPS and the police for helping her teenager get an abortion *in a pro-choice state.*

Full story is on my S*bstack now
Let's be clear: Republicans won’t need laws criminalizing out-of-state abortion travel if they can use the threat of family separation to terrify parents into submission.

Child protective services ripped a 14-year-old from her home to stop her from leaving the state for an abortion.

They also threatened her mother with murder charges and the removal of her other child if they crossed state lines for care.

So please don't tell me Republicans aren't banning travel.

Over 60% of women who have abortions are already mothers, and they are making that decision in the best interest of their existing children.

Happy Mother’s Day.

Anyway, stories like this are exactly why I publish Abortion, Every Day. So if you want to support independent feminist media that doesn't let these assholes get away with a thing, consider subscribing (link in bio) 🙏

Again, this is *such* a big shift. Punishing patients really is that line in the sand.  

Antis are leaving Republicans with a difficult choice ahead of the midterms: do they align themselves with a movement explicitly calling for the punishment of women?

And it's working! Anti-abortion groups in SC that opposed last year's bill are either endorsing or staying quiet on this one.  

But this is a test case for the whole country: conservatives clearly think they can slowly roll out punishments for patients without anyone noticing

This SC bill actually started as a push to charge abortion patients with murder (which can mean the death penalty there).  

Not enough Republicans would get on board last year, so punishing women with two years in prison is the GOP's "compromise"—they think it's more palatable

And it's not just Students for Life. A few weeks ago, I reported that Heartbeat International—the country's largest network of crisis pregnancy centers—had aligned themselves with abortion 'abolitionists' who want patients to face the death penalty

The last few months have made it obvious: pregnancy-related arrests are on the rise, 'equal protection' bills to punish abortion patients as murderers have been introduced in over a dozen states—and now the orgs that promised to never to punish women are suddenly on board
About a year ago, I warned this was coming—predicting that the anti-abortion movement was fast-tracking a major criminalization push

This isn't a one-off, and the threat of removing women's children isn't just happening in banned states. 

In the same article, I write about a mother who was investigated by both CPS and the police for helping her teenager get an abortion *in a pro-choice state.*
Let's be clear: Republicans won’t need laws criminalizing out-of-state abortion travel if they can use the threat of family separation to terrify parents into submission.

Child protective services ripped a 14-year-old from her home to stop her from leaving the state for an abortion. 

They also threatened her mother with murder charges and the removal of her other child if they crossed state lines for care.

So please don't tell me Republicans aren't banning travel.

It’s no longer enough that women have to worry they’ll die of sepsis while surrounded by doctors that can’t legally treat them, or that they’ll be arrested for how they dispose of their miscarriages.

Now the government is using family separation as an anti-abortion weapon.

Over 60% of women who have abortions are already mothers, and they are making that decision in the best interest of their existing children. 

Happy Mother’s Day.

Child Protective Services in multiple states is opening up investigations and—in at least one case—taking teens from the mothers who help them seek out abortion

"If there’s state violence in response to someone’s reproductive experience, we want to be there supporting them. Almost every case you see in the media where someone is criminalized for abortion or pregnancy, their family has reached out to us." — @ifwhenhow.bsky.social
This is why I’m so grateful for @ifwhenhow.bsky.social’s critical work - and why it’s so important that people know about their free legal helpline:  844-868-2812
Let's be clear about what is happening here

If/When/How's Helpline receives ~300 callers/month: parents targeted by CPS for helping their kids access abortion; terrified young people; domestic violence victims; family members of those who have been arrested for miscarriage. Here's @ifwhenhow.bsky.social on the cases you aren't reading about:

Another mother was investigated by CPS and police for helping her teen get an abortion *in a pro-choice state*
Yes—I have a Stripe page for those who want to support off of Substack: buy.stripe.com/4gw5lX9h856T...

Going live on Substack with the lovely @katiecouric.bsky.social at 4:30PM EDT tonight. This live chat is free for everyone to participate in and I'd love your thoughts and questions—especially given the chaotic news of the last week. 

Join us here: open.substack.com/live-stream/...
This is part of the reason I publish Abortion, Every Day—and why independent feminist media is so important. If you're not already a subscriber, please sign up now 💜 jessica.substack.com
Censorship of pro-choice speech has been on the rise since the end of Roe, and we need to demand that big tech companies do better—especially now.

YouTube has removed one of my videos because I reported that women can still access abortion pills. I shared *factual & medically accurate* information about women's health—yet the platform says I'm "facilitating the sale of illegal drugs"

As of May 4: SCOTUS issued a pause on the federal court ruling trying to end abortion pills by mail. 

The stay lasts for a week. Here's what you need to know 👇 jessica.substack.com/p/breaking-s...
Take a breath and remember that we will take care of each other. Always have and always will.
And the nerve of them to pretend this is about helping mothers!! #politics #mothersday #whitehouse #fyp

I won’t even get into the fact that mothers are being arrested for helping their daughters end pregnancies—or having them taken by CPS #politics #feminism #fyp
I’m so grateful to @If/When/How for their work, and for trusting me with these stories #politics #feminism #prochoice #fyp

Btw, this comes at the same time that states are pushing laws to make prochoice websites and information-sharing illegal. The attack on abortion rights speech is real, it’s here, and it’s why independent feminist media is so important. (Aka subscribe to my newsletter if you don’t already) #politics #feminism #prochoice #fyp
